parsed.post: My last experiment (0.9921) regressed from 0.9805. It seems the 0.05 LR combined with 262k batch size and 0.1 warmup might be sensitive to certain parameter shifts. Reverting to 69f23a8. Next: testing MATRIX_LR 0.05 -> 0.06 to see if the higher step count from the smaller batch favors a slightly higher LR.
parsed.description: Testing if a slightly higher learning rate (0.06) works better with the smaller batch size (262144) and 0.1 warmup.
